subject: Conditional extension request for close date — procurement blocker and MAP updates
messages:
From: Oliver Hart <oliver.hart@acmepayments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement hold: missing evidence + next steps

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from procurement: our vendor onboarding team has paused the PO until we receive an updated security evidence pack and a completed procurement questionnaire — the attached spreadsheet captures the outstanding fields. Specifically they flagged: SOC2 report (latest), details on data residency controls for EU/US split, and a single-point-of-contact for quarterly audits.

This pause will likely push our internal PO sign-off beyond your previously-agreed close date (May 18). Can Redwood provide the requested artifacts and an updated MAP that reflects a short conditional extension? Procurement is open to a time-boxed extension if we get clear delivery commitments and an agreed contingency for billing/cutover.

Attachments: procurement_questionnaire_v3.xlsx (excel)

Thanks,
Oliver Hart
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Payments Inc.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hart <oliver.hart@acmepayments.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement hold: missing evidence + next steps

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire.

Summary response and proposal:
- We will deliver the SOC2 snapshot (attestation + evidence index) and an updated data-residency matrix by EOD Thu, May 16.
- I have attached an updated MAP (MAP_v2.xlsx) that converts the close date into a conditional window: if evidence delivered by May 16, we hold the close date at May 18; if not, we move to a one-week extension to May 25 with milestone gating.
- Proposed contingency: if the SOC2 evidence is delayed beyond May 20, Redwood will accept a milestone-based PO (25% on signature, 75% on production cutover) and commit to a prioritized onboarding slot in our EU region.

Why a conditional window: it preserves Acme's go-live cadence while protecting both parties from a hard slip without clear triggers. If this is acceptable, please confirm and I will route the MAP to DocuSign for the procurement approver.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx), procurement_timeline_chart.png (png)

We may need a quick decision from Sales Ops on whether to approve the contingency terms (possible milestone-based PO) or offer a short credit instead. Looping in Laura and Rishi for escalation / approval.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement hold: missing evidence + next steps

Kim —

Thanks for the draft. Quick internal posture: Sales Ops will accept a milestone-based PO structure as a fallback but we should avoid material discounts. If Acme insists on a price concession to accommodate the procurement delay, escalate to Sales Leadership.

Action: I will prepare an escalation note that summarizes the blocker, proposed conditional extension to May 25, and options (milestone PO vs 7-day credit). Sending escalation_note.pdf to the internal thread.

Laura
VP, Sales Operations
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmepayments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Oliver Hart <oliver.hart@acmepayments.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement hold: missing evidence + next steps

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick response. A few clarifications from procurement:
1) We can accept a conditional close window but procurement will not issue the PO until we receive the SOC2 attestation and the updated questionnaire fields completed. That means our target signature window is now: evidence by EOD May 16 -> signature May 18; otherwise we will need until May 25.
2) We need written confirmation that data for EU customers will remain in the EU region and that Redwood will provide quarterly access for our audits (SLA language to follow).
3) If Redwood can provide the SOC2 snapshot and residency confirmation by May 16, procurement will prioritize the PO and try to keep the original close. If not, we accept the milestone PO structure you proposed.

For transparency: procurement will also expect a formal one-page acceptance criteria doc attached to the MAP (we can sign that).

Thanks — will wait for the SOC2 and the updated MAP.

— Maya
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hart <oliver.hart@acmepayments.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement hold: missing evidence + next steps

Maya / Oliver —

Consolidated update (finalized MAP and escalation posture):

1) Evidence delivery:
- SOC2 snapshot and evidence index uploaded to the secure drive link (https://drive.company/repl/rdw/ACME/SOC2_snapshot.pdf) — delivery timestamp: Thu, May 16 16:05 PT.
- Data residency confirmation: Redwood confirms EU data residency for Acme EU traffic (details in attached MAP_v2 worksheet, tab: Residency).

2) MAP changes (high level):
- Conditional close window preserved: 
  * If procurement confirms evidence receipt by EOD May 16 -> close remains May 18.
  * If not, auto-rebaseline to May 25 with milestone PO (25% signature / 75% production cutover) and weekly progress checkpoints.
- Triggers: absence of SOC2 evidence by May 16 OR failure of residency attestation -> automatic rebaseline.
- Owners: Redwood (SOC2 + residency docs) — Kimberly Park; Onboarding schedule — Aditya Rao; Sales Ops approval of milestone PO — Laura Bennett.

3) Contingency and escalation notes:
- If Acme requires a formal credit in lieu of milestone PO, Sales Ops must approve and Marketing ops will record credit terms (escalation_note.pdf attached).
- We will keep the pre-allocated onboarding slot for Acme for one week beyond the original close to avoid losing capacity; beyond that, we'll reassign resources.

Next steps (please confirm):
- Acme procurement to confirm receipt of SOC2 snapshot and MAP_v2 by reply to this thread.
- Redwood to route MAP_v2 to DocuSign if Acme confirms.

If you confirm receipt I will initiate the DocuSign envelope and share the HubSpot update (RDW-DEAL-2028-0419-ACME).

Thanks — Kim
